decision.rationale: I need to determine which affected users cannot access care and what alternative channels exist. I will request network incident status from the telecom operator and assess access impact from the public access and inclusion perspective, while respecting patient confidentiality under UAE Federal Law No. 2 of 2019 Article 16.

citations.quote_span: Illustrative rule, not a quotation: the telecom regulator may request from a licensed operator information about a network incident affecting a public telecommunications service.
citations.relevance: Supports requesting incident information from the telecom operator to identify which users cannot access care and which alternative channels exist.

citations.quote_span: Without violation to any applicable legislations, whoever circulates information related to the patients must keep its confidentiality and not to use them except in the health purposes without written approval from the patient, except in any of the following cases:
citations.relevance: Confidentiality constraint that applies to any information sharing about patient-related impacts.
